race_name: UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya

top_categories.workout_context: 65 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 65 miles.
UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Base fitness for UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
At UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 65 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at UCI Gran Fondo World Series Antalya requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.
